test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/564c53784e9af90f051ade8c37aee6203605b2956021c48210e02174a517c5c5.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) Middle arrow rotates anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a23b2fea52fc0c491f78e6c8b429ce785f01f6be508adb8cb696166f97e639ae.png] 

2) Heart and rhombus shape rotate anticlockwise square corner to corner and this figure also rotates anticlockwise at its own position

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ccbcb71bc4beb48abaf5c06855a02426108789cbb5e033e4a29d09f87c8f33c.png] 

Final series is

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09cda7d754b9cf35f141d397b22a1c5c0b841f4ea7f68c011f7f0c7c0bf9838c.png] 

Hence, **‘option 3’** is the correct answer.
